attributes.context: The following numbered provisions in the chunk set out the parties' procedure for permanent reductions, including advance notification of equipment shutdown, consultations to reach a written reassignment agreement, seniority and training considerations, and displaced-employee placement.

extraction_text: 3. Whenever the Company has made plans for the permanent reduction of the work force or changes which materially affect job and progression ladders, advance notice and consultation will be held with the Union Standing Committee.
